production_changes: One helper cutoff applies to poll, stop and cancel-race Disconnect entries.
The production service supplies fm1_ms before stop can submit Disconnect.

initial_test_failure.cause: The new service fixture expected two total attempts. Its intentional busy pre-poll adds a third attempt.
initial_test_failure.disposition: The fixture now measures the count before service and checks its increment. Production code did not change for this correction.

saved_probe_limit: The old standalone service simulation deliberately supplies stale time. It still fails against the repaired helper alone. The new regression extracts and executes the actual production caller. Its old-caller mutation fails and its repaired caller passes.
